out.title: Prithvi Vachani appointed Executive Director; Q2 results also announced
out.summary: Board appointed Prithvi Vachani (son of Chairman Sunil Vachani) as Additional Director/Executive Director for five years from 30 Oct 2026, subject to shareholder approval; also approved Q2 FY27 results.

person.name: Prithvi Vachani
person.bio: Vice President at Dixon; Bentley University graduate, MBA from London Business School; led boAt collaboration, Chennai facility, IT hardware partnerships with Asus and HP, and mobile accounts Jio and Xiaomi.
